attributes.residual:
IMPROVED and committed, three times. real 527 -> 627 (a RENAMING inflation, not a regression - see verification), objdiff fuzzy 94.1794% -> 97.4839%, instruction count T496/O485 -> T496/O491, opcode multiset 25t -> 11t, regnorm 102 STRUCTURAL / 22 genuine / 28 unpaired -> 95 STRUCTURAL / 9 genuine / 5 unpaired.

REMAINING RESIDUAL, ONE named class: target-only `+5 b +3 bne`, ours-only `-3 beq`, at +0x2a0, +0x328, +0x3a0, +0x4a4 and +0x598. Every instance is the same shape - the target emits a conditional branch OVER an unconditional branch (e.g. `cmpwi r3,1 / beq ->2a8 / b ->780`, where 0x2a8 is the instruction immediately after the `b`), and our build fuses the pair into one inverted conditional (`bne ->754`). Four of the five sit on the last conjunct of an `A && B && C` guard whose body is a bare `goto`, which our build folds into the conditional branch; the fifth is the `if (*(s32*)rec != 1) break;` early-exit at source line 2271. The peephole axis is measured dead (above). The untried hypothesis, and MANDATORY STEP 1 for the next lane on this function per AGENTS.md discipline 10b: make the if-body something other than a bare `goto` - the target's `b` is the body, so MWCC never had a single-branch body to fold. Concretely, try `break` out of the `for` with the k-test moved after the loop, and try the early-exit at 2271 rewritten as a positive `if (*(s32*)rec == 1) { <rest of case 2> }`.
